note: The story asks the officer to confirm, then generate the work order in excel format and download it. No code. The only traces are the comment '//? `reports/workorder/excel`' in Fapi.d.ts:307 (a type hint, not an endpoint) and export-to-excel code in ActionReport.tsx:88-120 that is entirely commented out. No reports/workorder controller exists in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi, and the excel layout for the service provider system is not defined in the repo. Other generic Excel generators (e.g. ExcelReportConfig in ocmsadminprivateapi) belong to other reports, not work orders, so they are not claimed. The only trace is the 'Workorder Reports' stub in the staff UI, commented out (ReportList.tsx:147-201) with an empty resource (ReportListWorkOrder.tsx:48). Story status is blank in stories.json (requirement not given). No matching maintenance ticket (grep work order/warrant/tagging/house visit in maintenance_tickets.csv: 0).
